label: Chave da API
hint: Google AI Studio → Get API key. Os modelos de imagem não têm cota grátis: o projeto precisa de faturamento ativo.

label: Modelo
hint: Preço por imagem de cerca de 1 MP.

label: Instrução para o modelo
hint: Em inglês. A primeira imagem é a foto do cliente; a segunda, a peça.
default: The first image is a photo of a person. The second image is a garment. Edit the first image: the person is now wearing the garment from the second image, copied exactly as it is (its cut, sleeves, neckline, color, print and length), without the hanger or anything visible inside it. A top is worn on the upper body, together with the same lower-body clothes and the same shoes as in the first image. A bottom is worn together with the same top as in the first image. Keep exactly the same face as in the first image (facial features, face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, teeth, expression, skin tone, makeup, head angle), and the same hair, accessories, hands, pose, body shape, background and lighting. Photorealistic, fully clothed.
